name: Terror Mastery [Psionic]
body:
You have learned to activate multiple terrors at a time.

Prerequisite: 8 terrors known.

Benefit: When you use your terrors class feature, you can activate two terrors in a single swift action.

Normal: You can only activate one terror at a time.
